ontologySymbols: deterministic Phase A workpack authority tests
Phase A confirmation revision CAS route tests

requiredResolution.revisionDomains: Share canonicalWorkpackRevision remains a SHA-256 content hash. Ontology revision and updatedAt remain the same RFC3339 workpacks.updated_at CAS value. Neither domain may substitute for or be merged into the other.
requiredResolution.ontologyServerAuthority: Preserve deterministic workpack ID, exact authenticated row, generation seal, user, organization, site, and server-confirmed Phase A authority checks.
requiredResolution.evidenceSummaryOverlay: Preserve the full raw evidence_summary object and overlay canonical confirmation fields without deleting unknown reviewedLocalizationEnvelopes, dispatch, localization, or other keys.
requiredResolution.localizationEnvelopeHandling: Unknown localization envelope keys survive; stale reviewedLocalizationEnvelopes are revalidated against current row authority and never trusted blindly.
requiredResolution.localizationReviewInvalidation: Any localization review that updates workpacks.updated_at invalidates Phase A authority and the Share request scope; reread the authenticated row before continuing.
requiredResolution.confirmationCas: Preserve workpacks.updated_at compare-and-swap, strictly newer updated_at, confirmationId replay/conflict handling, and no last-write-wins fallback.
requiredResolution.shareRequestScope: Preserve request identity/version guards so accepted, partial, failed, session, provider, and log outcomes from an old workpack, target, channel, or authority scope cannot update the current UI.
requiredResolution.dispatchCas: Preserve workpack_share_sessions.access_policy transitions ready-to-reserved-to-recorded-or-uncertain with equality on the previously read session updated_at.
requiredResolution.shareWorkspaceState: Final semantic merge retains initialWorkpackId, initialWorkpackAuthority, requiresRevalidation, theme/workspaceTheme, validated Share URL state, and request-scope identity/version guards.
requiredResolution.harnessTeardown: Combine taskkill status/error verification and process close semantics with ontology exit waiting, temp-directory retries, and the file-based Next runner; teardown must fail closed and leave zero Share processes.
requiredResolution.testResolution: Retain actual route authority/CAS tests, Phase A exact-row tests, in-flight Share scope race tests, localization completeness tests, and harness teardown regression tests.

prohibitedResolution: Substituting Share canonicalWorkpackRevision for ontology revision/updatedAt or vice versa
Dropping revision, updatedAt, canonicalWorkpackRevision, or evidenceSummary
Replacing raw evidence_summary instead of overlaying canonical confirmation fields
Dropping unknown reviewedLocalizationEnvelopes, dispatch, localization, or other evidence_summary keys
Trusting stale localization envelopes without current-row revalidation
Retaining Phase A authority or Share request scope after localization review changes workpacks.updated_at
Dropping initialWorkpackId, initialWorkpackAuthority, requiresRevalidation, theme, Share URL state, or request-scope guards
Replacing confirmation or dispatch CAS with last-write-wins
Applying an old Share outcome after request scope changes
Silently ignoring browser harness process termination failure
Treating a clean main merge-tree or auto-merge as semantic approval
Resolving ontology conflicts on the Share branch
